Domino1 topples across a 0.18 m spacing and touches ball2 at the high end of ramp1. Ball2 rolls down ramp1, whose low end is 0.15 m above the floor, crosses a 0.10 m gap, and touches door1. Pendulum1, a 0.50 m long, 0.35 kg rigid pendulum, swings clockwise through 38 degrees and touches block1. Block1 slides 0.35 m across the floor and touches cart2. Cart2 slides 0.42 m and touches the left end of seesaw1, a 0.65 by 0.10 by 0.04 m, 0.55 kg center-hinged beam carrying ball3 on its right end. Ball4 falls into cup1, whose inner footprint is 0.30 by 0.30 m with 0.20 m high and 0.02 m thick walls, and comes to rest there.
